mechanical_inventory.locator: Product description and What's in the box
mechanical_inventory.scope: Manufacturer lists ABXY, view/menu/share/Xbox buttons, bumpers, triggers, D-pad and two stick caps for model 1914. No dimensions or dynamics supplied.

algorithm.locator: simplices, equations, volume and Qhull notes
algorithm.scope: Convex enclosure of source vertices; algorithm source only, NOT evidence that a controller part is convex.

design.purpose: Generate and quantify an ABXY collision candidate, not automatically approve it
design.selection_basis: Object labels in verified source inventory, corroborated as button categories by Microsoft inventory. Excludes decorative letters and other internal visual pieces; correspondence still needs review.
design.coordinate_policy: Unchanged source world coordinates; no physical scale or pivot inferred
design.hull_policy: Use Qhull without point-joggling or geometry perturbation. Retain hull vertices from original mesh only.
design.surface_metric: Bidirectional distances at all vertices and triangle centroids; finite sampling, NOT exact Hausdorff distance
design.shell_policy: Do not convexify shell as one body: control openings and internal clearances have not been verified
design.other_controls: D-pad, sticks, shoulders and triggers not covered by this candidate algorithm
design.numerical_tolerance: 128 * float64 machine epsilon * max absolute source coordinate; roundoff check only, not a physical contact tolerance
design.allowed_use: geometry inspection only; no mass, contact material or simulator default assignments

assembly_diagnostic.source: build/experiments/legacy_casper_1914_visual_parts/inventory.json and its pinned Blender source hash
assembly_diagnostic.version_scope: Online API documentation currently 5.1.1; executed implementation version is recorded in results and tested on synthetic geometry
assembly_diagnostic.grouping: For each ABXY, compare Button-only hull to named letter, Button, Interior and Interior2 objects together. This grouping is diagnostic, not approved mechanical connectivity.
assembly_diagnostic.method: Same vertex/face-centroid sampling as the original audit, now retaining the maximum-distance point pair and target triangle for inspection
